'''Mohn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who worked for the [[Workers]]. He participated in a secret meeting of a group of miners under the leadership of [[rini]]. After [[Lenz]] had informed the group that the [[Absolutes]] had begun to monitor the workers, he and [[Winati]] were commissioned to try and find suitable places for their meeting.
